The update list is now signed together with each release's channel, a serial and an expiry date, so a site refuses an old, expired or altered list, a beta presented as stable, and a package older than the installed version; the hub says why. New shared security helpers. Update recommended.

* New: optional own tab «Ξεφυλλίστε το βιβλίο» / "Leaf through the book" on every product with a visible sample (Settings → "Also in its own tab"), with its title in Greek and English. With the position "Only with the shortcode or the block" the tab holds the only button on the page. Key bpv_preview, priority 35, so Product Tabs can order, rename or hide it with the other tabs.

* New: optional backups to your own Dropbox (App folder only). Connect in DM Settings with a pasted code (OAuth 2 with PKCE); the token is sealed with the keys of wp-config.php or set as a constant, and never goes into a backup.
* New: choose where each backup goes (server, server and Dropbox, only Dropbox) for manual backups, schedules and WP-CLI (`--dest`). Dropbox copies are encrypted by default; the server copy is deleted only after a checked upload.
* New: uploads in pieces of 4/8/16 MB with retries, per-schedule retention in Dropbox and an optional size limit, "Read backups in Dropbox", "Send to Dropbox" and "Get from Dropbox".
* The database dump now skips the plugin's own Dropbox token rows.

stable.changelog:
* New: automatic schedule of the write window, per site (Access → Window schedule, off by default). Up to 3 ranges a day in the site's time zone, a range may run past midnight, up to 30 closed dates. Ranges that touch count as one stretch, and no stretch may be longer than 12 hours (the longest manual window); a DST night is cut at 12 hours too. Worked out on every check, so it is right without cron; one WP-Cron event at the next change only writes the log and sends the e-mail.
* New: "Close now" inside a scheduled stretch (WP admin, Hub, app or Claude's write_window_close) pauses the schedule until that stretch ends; the next one opens as planned. Opening by hand inside a stretch keeps the later end.
* New: an e-mail to the admin address for every change of the write window: opened or closed by hand (and by whom: WP admin, Hub, app or Claude), opened or closed by the schedule, paused, and every schedule edit (before and after). Setting in Access, on by default.
* The site's status gives the Hub and the app what keeps the window open (manual / schedule), the next scheduled opening and the end of a pause; the Hub's Sites tab and list_sites show them. The Site Bridge app 1.8.0 notifies about every change.
* The schedule lives in option sbr_schedule, which no Site Bridge tool can write. Uninstall removes it and its cron event.
